This document outlines the equipment inspection checklist I1, to 
be performed 
on a monthly bases
as indicated by M1 in the title block The first draft initiated by eng. Emad Farouk Moustafa, tested 07 July 
02 at El-Katamia 220kv substation Cairo zone

items: A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,

Safety fence (rope) with caution 
marks surrounding the work area,

Wear the appropriate personal protective tools "safety shoes, helmet 
 breathing mask, safety glasses"
The CB switched off and earthing switch must be closed on both sides of the breaker
Change selector switch to maintenance position.
Set of common keys, blowers, cleaning clothe,
Personal protective tools

Mechanical oil type ESSO J13 if needed 
 to added

Check the oil level for the circuit breaker mechanism in the main tank through the gauge, 
 add if needed.

Open the box of mechanism and take a look for any oil leake through the 
 system, if found try to prevent it.

Switch off the pump16670 from local panel, and open the stop valve 16613 fig 
 4/16
Check the oil pressure through pressure gauge, it will be dropped from 34.2MPa to 20MPa slowly, after that it will drop to zero quickly.

Check the indications for each stop of pressure gauge
 at 29.7 MPa 
 oil pressure low
 at 28.2 MPa 
 close circuit inoperative
 at 26.6 MPa 
 trip circuit inoperative

Close the stop value and switch on the pump, the motor pump will start and oil 
 pressed again to normal pressure 34.2MPa.
Observe that the indications will be disappeard one by one.
Check that the motor pump will stop when the pressure of oil reach 34.2MPa.
Check all pipes and screws for any leakage, retight the screws if needed.
Check the heater under hydrogen tank (accumulator) and be sure it work
Check all electric connections, auxilairies circuits
Check the denisty monitor for each step of SF6 gas pressure. ( 7.0bar at 20C )
Check supply voltage.
Check the earthed connection.

After finishing observation be sure that the door 
 of mechanism is closed correctly.
